Hi there,

I'm sorry for the trouble, especially with your team's deadline today — let's get this sorted right away.

A few quick things to try first:
1. Check your spam/junk/promotions folder for an email from noreply@loopwise.com.
2. If you have an email filter or firewall on your work domain, ask your IT team to allowlist that address, as reset emails are sometimes blocked silently.
3. Double-check that you're entering the exact email address associated with your Loopwise account (if you have multiple emails, try any alternates you may have used to sign up).

If none of those resolve it, please reply with:
- The email address you're using to log in
- The name of your workspace (if you know it)

I'll manually verify your account status and trigger a reset from our end, or escalate to our team immediately given your deadline so we can get you back in as fast as possible.

Thanks for your patience — we'll prioritize this.

Best,
Loopwise Support
